html:
Somaliland is the northwestern region of Somalia, the former British Somaliland, which declared itself independent on 18 May 1991, after the fall of Siad Barre.

Its leaders, mainly from the Isaaq clan who had suffered the bombing of Hargeisa, said the union of 1960 was over. Clan elders made peace through long conferences, and Somaliland built its own government, army, currency and elections.

It has held several contested elections with peaceful changes of power, unlike the rest of Somalia in the civil war. Almost no country recognises it, though its port of Berbera has drawn foreign investment.
sum: Somaliland is the northwestern region of Somalia, the former British Somaliland, which declared itself independent on 18 May 1991, after the fall of Siad Barre.
